name: launch-anything
title: Product Showcase
description: A 26.7-second editorial product film in cream and forest green: chrome-like words open onto a dusk horizon, a button becomes a portal into a desk, a laptop camera move steps through seven product screens, a symbol field, architectural linework, two launch plates, a typed address and a frame-shaped mark. Silent: sound is added by the host. Photographs are drawn with SVG by default (the chrome type is a 2D approximation of the shader); pass image paths to use real photos.
useWhen: You want a complete 26.7-second product film with editable text and demonstrations.
Your portfolio needs a continuous laptop camera move through seven product examples.
avoidWhen: You want to introduce a complete visual identity: use brand-guidelines.
You only need a chrome headline: use shader-text-reveal.
author: Remocn
